## EvaluateLayeredPolicyOptions.keyPolicy property

The authenticated API key's own policy, when it has one. Omitted or `undefined` means the host policy alone governs — identical to the behavior before per-key policies existed.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly keyPolicy?: GovernancePolicy | undefined;
```
